message:
The yen receipt test now passes, and so does the rest of the suite (18 of 18).

The cause was `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It always divided by 100 and printed two decimals, so 500 JPY came out as `¥5.00`. I added a zero-decimal currency set (currently just `JPY`), so yen amounts are shown as-is with no decimals (`¥500`).

`formatMoney` is shared, so cart totals and invoice lines now show yen correctly too. They had the same bug. No existing tests cover those paths with yen.
